--DROP VIEW BI_KatomAssortment;
--DROP EXTERNAL TABLE SLS.KatomAssortment;

--External Table
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE SLS.KatomAssortment (
    [SKU] nvarchar(4000),
    [Aligned Item Number] nvarchar(4000),
    [M3 Model Number] nvarchar(4000),
    [Brand] nvarchar(4000),
    [Item Type] nvarchar(4000),
    [Status] nvarchar(4000)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'Salsify/KatomAssortment_PowerBI.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = [tlclakefs_tlclake_dfs_core_windows_net],
    FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseDelimitedTextFormatQuote]
);
GO

--View
--SELECT * FROM BI_KatomAssortment

CREATE VIEW BI_KatomAssortment
AS

SELECT
    [SKU] AS [Salsify SKU],
    [Aligned Item Number],
    [M3 Model Number],
    [Brand],
    [Item Type],
    [Status],
    CASE
        WHEN [M3 Model Number] IS NOT NULL
             AND LTRIM(RTRIM([M3 Model Number])) <> ''
        THEN [M3 Model Number]
        ELSE [SKU]
    END AS [Item Number]

FROM SLS.KatomAssortment
